annotations.title: Emissions sources this key can read

description: Emissions Data is a separate dataset, not one of the fundamentals markets: greenhouse gas and related figures from public registers, and estimates in a separate modelled layer, each row as its source publishes it. This lists the sources, layers and ID types the API key's licence includes, with each source's name, section of the Source Conditions Schedule, row counts and years. Available only with an API key whose licence includes Emissions Data; any other call returns a short notice.

compact.description: true leaves out schema and entitlement and gives each row's attribution notice by reference; default false
